detailed_descriptions_html.en:
A rainbow metropolis awaits! Join Usahana in City Town and discover a world of creativity, friendship, and fun. Run your own customizable Imagination Cafe, set up all-new shops with Sanrio friends, and unlock the power of dreams to uncover the City’s hidden wonders.

  • Welcome, Usahana! Become best friends and unlock 35 friendship levels

  • Explore City Town with 90+ original quests and 30+ hours of adventure

  • Unlock New Outfits and Decor, including over 150+ new clothing and furniture items

  • Run Your Own Cafe – customize your space and craft your own orders for Sanrio friends

  • Solve 60+ Puzzles and Challenges throughout (and beneath!) the City

  • Plushies, Orchards, Arcades, and more! Help your Sanrio friends open seven new shops in City Town

  • Create Custom Avatar Palettes and switch between your favorite outfits for that perfect look

  • Unlock a Customizable Apartment Complex inside the Rainbow Tower

  • Meet Usahana’s Visitor Friends: Panya, Buppi, Wanwa, Sora, and Nyako

  • And… keep an eye out for a mysterious cameo guest
